ip_compliance: Aggregate counts and factual paper IDs only. No titles, abstracts, or reviewer text reproduced.

stage_1_identification.note_on_raw_hits: Per-cell raw OpenAlex hit counts are printed to stderr by scripts/diagnostics/discover_corpus.py but NOT persisted. Only the post-filter, post-dedup union is saved to discovery-candidates.json. Recoverable only by re-running OpenAlex queries (subject to result drift).
stage_1_identification.note_on_cell_totals: Cell totals double-count cross-query overlaps within a journal. The 614 figure is the unique-DOI union after in-journal cross-query dedup; cell totals sum to 614 only because each candidate is recorded with the FIRST query that matched it (no double-counting in this serialization). Sum check: 163 + 305 + 146 = 614; 250 + 91 + 79 + 53 + 36 + 34 + 49 + 22 = 614.

filters.name: title_keyword_filter
filters.rule: title (lowercased) must contain at least one ML word AND at least one medical word
filters.verification_note: NOT DIRECTLY LOGGED. Per-query raw OpenAlex hit count is printed to stderr but not persisted. Manual verification requires replaying OpenAlex queries.

filters.name: doi_dedup_against_existing_kb
filters.rule: exclude DOIs already present in peer-review-kb.json at run time
filters.verification_note: Lower bound only. In-loop dedup of duplicate DOIs across queries within the same journal is not separately counted.

stage_3_eligibility.method: Per candidate: fetch nature.com/articles/<doi_short>, locate <a data-track-label='peer review file'>, download linked PDF, verify %PDF- magic bytes

exclusion_reasons_aggregate.note: Per-DOI status not retained at full granularity. paper/expanded-corpus-status.json contains a 5-DOI sample only. Aggregate narrative in peer-review-kb.json#/provenance/integrity_audits[1].known_issues_for_paper_writeup attributes the 305/305 npj Digital Medicine skip to systematic author opt-out from transparent peer review at that journal.

stage_3_eligibility.verification_note: Per-DOI eligibility-skip reasons are NOT LOGGED at full granularity. Only the journal-level totals (29 / 63 / 305) and the narrative attribution (npj DM systematic TPR opt-out) are recoverable.

stage_4_audit.method: 5 parallel agents performed strict per-entry audit on 217 PR-EXP entries (PDF-title alignment, structured field extraction, anomaly flagging, is_cohort_retrospective_binary classification)

is_cohort_retrospective_binary.note: The 92 'false' set is the disjoint complement of the 125 'true' (per-entry boolean). The 92 includes the 15 topic_not_medical_ml entries and the un-redownloadable corrupt PDFs (which were tagged false-or-uncertain by the audit). Do not sum (6 corrupt + 15 topic + 92 non-cohort) as disjoint exclusions: total disjoint exclusion = 217 - 125 = 92.

cross_chunk_consistency.note: Year-controlled comparison (2025 only): chunk 1 = 4.3% true vs chunk 3 = 72.2% true. Skew not explained by year drift alone; likely labeling-rubric divergence between agents. Manual re-spot of ~10 chunk-1 entries recommended in corpus-statistics.md s10.

code_repo_breakdown.note: github/zenodo/figshare counts overlap (papers can have multiple repos).

quarantined.reason_summary: DOI resolved to an unrelated genome paper; title contained explicit '(inferred from PDF content)' marker - apparent fabrication.

verification_flags.explanation: Per-cell raw OpenAlex hit counts are printed to stderr by discover_corpus.py but never persisted. Only the post-filter union (614) is saved.
verification_flags.remediation: Replay OpenAlex queries (subject to result drift since 2026-05-10).

verification_flags.explanation: Same as VF-01 - title-filter rejections happen inline in the discovery loop and are not counted in the output JSON.
verification_flags.remediation: Re-run discover_corpus.py with a counter patch, or replay queries.

verification_flags.explanation: Logged value 112 is the count of pre-existing KB DOIs excluded; in-loop dedup of duplicates ACROSS queries within the same journal is not separately counted.
verification_flags.remediation: Patch discover_corpus.py to emit per-query overlap stats.

verification_flags.explanation: paper/expanded-corpus-status.json contains a 5-DOI sample (3 downloaded, 2 no_peer_review_file). The full 614-row status table was not retained. Journal-level totals (29 NC / 63 CommMed / 305 npjDM skipped) and narrative attribution (npjDM = systematic author opt-out from TPR) are documented.
verification_flags.remediation: Re-run download_discovered_pdfs.py with full-status logging; or use HTML cache in .cache/nature_html/ to re-derive per-DOI TPR-anchor presence.

verification_flags.explanation: topic_not_medical_ml (n=15), pdf_corrupt_or_empty (n=6), and is_cohort_retrospective_binary==false (n=92) are NOT mutually exclusive. The 92 'false' is the disjoint complement of the 125 'true' (217 - 125 = 92) and INCLUDES the topic-mismatch entries. Do not sum 6+15+92 in PRISMA exclusion box.
verification_flags.remediation: Use disjoint exclusion total of 92 in PRISMA Stage 4 box; report 6 corrupt and 15 topic-mismatch as sub-categories of the 92.

verification_flags.explanation: Chunk 1 vs Chunk 3 cohort-rate gap is 79.5 pp (9.1% vs 88.6%); year-controlled (2025-only) gap is 67.9 pp. Indicates labeling-rubric divergence between agents.
verification_flags.remediation: Manual re-spot of ~10 chunk-1 entries before publishing the 125 in-scope figure (per corpus-statistics.md s10).

verification_flags.explanation: Two markers of corrupt PDFs disagree: _pdf_status == 'corrupt_needs_redownload' is set on 4 entries (0007, 0044, 0080, 0150); audit_findings.anomaly_flags includes pdf_corrupt_or_empty for 6 entries (adds 0188, 0190).
verification_flags.remediation: Reconcile to one canonical field (per corpus-statistics.md s10 finding 2).

verification_flags.explanation: OpenAlex discovery returned 305 candidates from npj Digital Medicine but 0 verified peer-review PDFs (100% skip at eligibility). Cause: most npjDM authors did not opt in to transparent peer review at that journal.
verification_flags.remediation: Disclose in paper Methods. The 217-entry PR-EXP layer is 100% Nature Communications + Communications Medicine.
